title: National Commission's Power to Declare Unfair Contract Terms Null and Void

content.scenario: A consumer files a complaint with the National Commission alleging that a term in their contract with a service provider is unfair. The National Commission investigates and finds the term to be indeed unfair.
content.outcome: The National Commission may declare the unfair term of the contract null and void, as per Section 59(2) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: Can the National Commission declare unfair contract terms null and void?
What is the process for declaring unfair contract terms null and void?
What are the consequences of a term being declared null and void?
